rationale: Repairs the stable v1.82.0 native lifecycle fences that retain an old Dreame full path after compatible transport map/frame changes. The saved-coordinate and async owner guards remain; no new user setting or provider is introduced.

summary.en: Fix stale Dreame trails across cleanups and identify retained errored paths in diagnostics.
